review.official:
Lin Qingyan, former deputy minister at
Yan
's Judicial Review Office. She returned to the
Tianshi
Bureaus to study Lei Fa after resigning from her post, stopping at Rhodes Island during her journeys and taking part in some field missions.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Leizi shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Leizi rarely comes into contact with Originium.

I laid down casually upon hearing the news that Leizi was visiting Rhodes Island again, then sit back up when I saw her updated resume. This time, she comes as a Tianshi, and her investigation authorization with Rhodes Island has expired. Does this mean that Rhodes Island no longer needs to be on guard with her official background?
One thing is clear at least—her movements are now regular and predictable. Thundercracks can be heard from the training room at the crack of dawn when she is not on missions, then she can be seen reading in the library in the afternoon. She completes her missions flawlessly and without complaint. She is a regular visitor to the bar with Blaze, though she never drinks herself. Other than requesting to see Zuo Le's mission assessments on her, she has never made any unusual requests.
This change in Leizi must have something to do with the case she had been working on for years, though the incessant pursuit of justice always comes at a price, especially for someone as stubborn and unwavering as her. She has never been overly concerned with titles and power, but that was hardly the only price she paid. It had long occurred to me that life would not be easy for someone like her, and the path that her lightning illuminates is often a treacherous one.
We do not pry into her private life, as long as it does not affect the operations she takes part in. Whether she sees her work here as a kind of R&R or a trial for herself, her performance is exemplary, and it has been a long time since I have received a complaint about her breaking any electrical appliances. That alone is reason enough to welcome her continued presence on Rhodes Island.

Leizi entered the Tianshi Bureaus at a young age. Her background brought her into contact with masters such as Cyanstorm Count since her youth, but even she could not become his pupil without going through the Bureaus' application process. Public examinations are the only way to be accepted into the Tianshi Bureaus; everyone is assessed in the same way, with no shortcuts or backdoors.
Yan's public examinations are famously difficult. It is extremely rare for an underage student to pass them, and many examinees have spent decades memorizing the books yet still fail to pass. The Lei Fa examination in particular requires examinees to demonstrate both outstanding aptitude for thunder-related Arts, as well as excellent knowledge and understanding of the laws of Yan. It takes considerable time for the average student to master even one of these two.
As one of the youngest students of the Tianshi Bureaus, Leizi was also known for rejecting a visit from Cyanstorm Count during her examination preparation to avoid any appearance of impropriety, even though the elderly Tianshi had only intended to give a few tips to the promising student without revealing any confidential information. In the end, she passed the examinations without any help.
There is a Yanese saying that a child's demeanor at the age of three reveals everything about the rest of their life. Leizi seems to be living proof of it: no longer burdened by holding a formal office, she enjoys chatting over a drink at the bar with Blaze. As long as her conviction remains firm, there is nothing that can break her.

These sorts of problems were commonplace in the thirteen villages and towns that I visited on my journey to the west this year. A typical case would be an old farmer whose land was forcibly purchased without receiving proper compensation. With his pleas ignored by the officials, he was forced to turn to theft to survive, but was promptly arrested. In despair over the future of his family, he was about to hang himself in front of the government office when I ran across him.
I was shocked at first, but as I studied the laws regarding the purchase and sale of land, I found that there were certain gray areas that could entrap a farmer into signing an unfair contract. I spent hours looking into books and records, but was still unable to find a legal basis to claim justice for the farmer. In the end, I offered to help him in a different way.
On the day that the land was scheduled to be handed over, the buyer came to run the farmer out. He laughed at the farmer and said the contract was signed without duress and was perfectly lawful, that he could go to the courts if he had a problem and not even heaven could do anything about it. At that moment, a crack of thunder rang out from a cloudless sky, following the buyer wherever he went. Believing that he had incurred the wrath of heaven, he finally coughed up the compensation.
The issue was resolved, but my heart remained uneasy. Thunder might achieve justice for one man, but it takes a meticulous code of law to achieve justice for all. As such, I propose the following amendments to the relevant laws...
—From Leizi's legal studies reports during her time as a student at the Tianshi Bureaus

Once we let our guard down around Leizi during her second stint on Rhodes Island, we found her to be unpretentious and easy to get along with. We were able to satisfy our curiosity and learn more about Lei Fa, a traditional school of Originium Arts that has special significance in Yan.
We knew that Lei Fa was more than just a kind of Arts for Yan, and represents both personal excellence and public justice. From Leizi's experiences during her studies, however, we've seen that the legacy of Lei Fa is passed down in a far more down-to-earth way than we thought. As a recognized heir of Lei Fa, she spends half her time at the Tianshi Bureau working on her Arts skills, learning not just how to control thunder and lightning, but also natural sciences such as meteorology and physics. The other half of her time is spent studying the laws and judgments of Yan.
Other than the use of thunder-realated Arts, heirs of Lei Fa seem no different from other law students. They usually go on to work in Yan's judiciary after they graduate. Each generation of heirs, however, work diligently on their Arts, because thunder and lightning carry great significance in Yanese culture. They represent divine judgment, signifying the people's hopes that those who do evil will by smote by lightning. Heirs of Lei Fa study Arts less for their practical value in combat, but for how they support their conviction to punish evil.
We have spoken to Leizi about her future. Although we would certainly welcome such an outstanding operator, with no official ties to any government, participating in Rhodes Island's operations for the long haul, we also understand that she cannot cast her responsibilities aside as an heir to Lei Fa.
Leizi does not avoid the topic when asked; she admits that she is thinking about returning to the Judicial Review Office, though she has not given us a specific timeline. The path to achieving spiritual excellence could take days, months, or years, but she is happy to go with her heart. With a clear goal in mind, she now takes things much easier than before.

After the matter of Mangshan Town was concluded, the geist of a silk fan followed Leizi for a while, tripping her as she walked and cooling her food when she ate. She paid it little heed, but decided to question it when she realized that it had followed her all the way to the border of town. To her surprise, she learned that the geist sought death after seeing how she had rid a sword of its geisthood with lightning.
The geist had wanted to become human for years, but had become disillusioned after seeing the chaos that engulfed Mangshan Town, and the treacherous and greedy side of humanity. Feeling that there was little meaning in becoming human after all, it believed only a quick end by lightning could grant it eternal peace.
I was curious as to how Leizi dealt with it, whether she brought the lightning down or not, but she continued with her monologue, saying that humans could be greedy and selfish, but they were also responsible for so many wonderful things in life, and that recognizing this was the first step to becoming human, and that it was understandable that the geist found it hard to accept.
I agreed with her and said that there will always be people who refuse to give in to the sinful nature of man. However, virtue need not stand alone if one finds friends who share the same ideals.
In the end, Leizi never told me what happened to the geist, but I thought I saw a pair of curious eyes on the fan that she casually took out as she was talking, taking in every detail of the world around it.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Give those documents here. Steady diligence paves the way to grand vision. During my cultivation retreat, I would grade ninety-nine assignments for the Tianshis every day—Halt. Where do you think you're going? Are you planning to dump your work on me to loaf about like the rest of them? Very well. Ignorance of consequence is bliss.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The case is closed. I can only hope Blaze is no longer shackled by her past, though it's hard not to worry for someone with her temperament. Never mind, I am simply visiting this time around—She won't be back for another two weeks? Ahem, staying a few more days will do me no harm. If there is anything I can help with, just say the word.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I must stress that Lei Fa is neither for quick-charging batteries nor invoking rain and storm! This Tianshi garb attracts many curious questions, and I am compelled to answer them all—Repairing a burnt circuit...? Give it here. This has nothing to do with Lei Fa either! I simply have a lot of practical experience in this field.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Zuo Le has been taking on more important duties at the Sui Regulator, but he still possesses the heart of a youth. He may seem a cautious young man, but he lets emotion get the better of him at crucial moments. How is one not meant to worry...? Why are you looking at me like that? I promised my sworn sister I would look after him, so naturally I'm concerned for him—Seriously, why are you looking at me like that?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: During my studies at the Tianshi Bureaus, I would never dare to neglect my Lei Fa drills or memorization of the law. But work at the Judicial Review Office requires human interaction. I was at a loss, but I came to realize something at last: when all is said and done, what both roles seek is nothing more than the truth.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: I may have shed my mandarin's robe, but I do not dwell on it. As a former enforcer of the law, I am well aware of its imperfections. There are times when swords are chipped and thunder falls silent. The law, Lei Fa, and the longsword are simply tools to punish evil and drive out wickedness. So long as the wielder is of resolute heart, there is nothing they cannot overcome.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Of course Tianshis are ordinary people, not cultivators of immortality. The Tianshi Bureaus were placed atop a mountain's peak simply for solitude's sake, allowing students to focus on their studies. Inconvenient? The Originium contraptions produced by the Chamber of Alchemy are perfectly sufficient to our daily needs. Besides, one can ride a Tianshi's Wing to the Baizao market and back in the span of a single joss stick. There's nothing inconvenient about it.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: You are worried. If life's challenges have left you with a weary heart, then follow me back to the Tianshi Bureaus to seclude your mind. Choose a research topic to your liking, suffer the torment of fanciful and enthusiastic Tianshis for a few years, and your heart shall be clear as crystal— To decline with such formality... Are my jokes still too serious?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I once saw a dastardly criminal who had been pronounced innocent struck by a bolt from the blue on his way home. Not far off, there was my little uncle who had no business there. I had hoped to question him, but in the end, I hid it away in my heart—Why am I telling you? Weren't we exchanging secrets?!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Do not push yourself. As a leader, you should recuperate when appropriate. A well-rested mind is an agile, observant mind. You can't finish your work? You want my help? Ridiculous! Preposterous! ...Give it here.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: I am here to terminate my investigation authorization with your company. And here is my new application for—'Thank goodness'? I am applying as an ordinary visitor, merely here to talk. I, Leizi of Great Yan's Tianshi Bureaus, do beg your pardon for my continued presence.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It is worth considering Originium Arts doctrine in a complex battlefield environment.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I do not grant my trust lightly, but Rhodes Island has proven itself a trustworthy organization. Do not disappoint me. Oh, I was talking over you? My apologies. Please, go ahead.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: When I first joined the Judicial Review Office, I strove to be the best in all things. I thought the higher I stood, the more I could do. And yet, it was the same thought that bade me leave. Do I regret it? No. Listen to the rumbling of the thunder. Where can its mighty roar not be heard? Where can its brilliant bolts not reach?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: When one learns from experience, the lessons never cease.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Levin crack umbra, luminate the path.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: With my blade, I decree—

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: There is no cure for the shameless.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I am here.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: A fine decision.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Practice without principle is the height of folly.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Amidst lightning flash, thund'rous sword shall clash!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Five thunders, smite the wicked!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: With trine blade shall evil be excised, with righteous fulgur's strike shall demons die!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Tremble, villains! Quake, ye ghouls! For thunder roars, and heaven shakes!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: There is no flight from Heaven's bolts!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: You should maintain such a high standard in future battles. You are the one who sets the standard, of course, but that does not mean you can be complacent!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: You have improved. Less admonition next time? That would be complacency. I rescind my earlier praise!

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Phew...What you need is time to clear your mind. As one of Rhodes Island's leaders, you must not make the same mistake twice. Remember this.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Stand and fight alongside me! I know you are not so easily defeated!

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: My idle days must be spent on thorough study. If there are any further explosions outside my door—There won't be? Very well. I trust you.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Calm mind, tranquil heart—I shall not bicker with you.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: It's only a handshake, no need to be so cautious. I haven't shocked anybody in years—Ah. Static does not count.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Fresh atmosphere brought by Spring squalls, many wills make new walls—Does this call for a little more passion? Hmm, I'll clench a fist at the end. Alright, from the top. What do you mean, 'there's no need'? Since Rhodes Island invited me to participate in the New Year's performance, I shall give my full effort!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: According to the schedule, you should not be resting here right now, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Congratulations on the anniversary of your birth. I, Leizi of the Tianshi Bureaus, offer you this device, with absolute certitude you shall put it to good use. You need only press the button—Don't point it at yourse—... Are you alright? Wake up! I was about to say you should press it when you are in danger, at which point the lightning I stored in it would be released...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I must admit, I had many reservations about Rhodes Island due to your connection with that particular case. But now, when I join you on missions, it is not for observation's sake. To aid the weak and demand justice are not such different goals. May our collaboration continue on.
